proposals.reason: Chinese 威 is “Might/Authority,” distinct from 武 in 武牙; literal English wrongly starts with “Martial”.

decisions.reason: s0116 lists 威、武牙將軍 as two titles (parallel to 曠野、橫野將軍); 威 is distinct from 武, so replacing the collapsed “Martial and Martial-Fang” with “Might and Martial-Fang” restores the correct first title without other changes.
The same 威、武牙 pair opens the literal sentence; rendering 威 as “Martial” conflates it with 武 in 武牙, and “Might and Martial-Fang Generals” correctly separates the two titles.
